author: Mark Atwood
text:
INDEPENDENT AUDIT (store re-read after publication, 2026-09-09; script at /tmp/opencode/hpc8-audit/).

1. SCOPE COVERAGE: all 13 x7hh children have leaves — .1:4, .2:3, .3:2, .4:2, .5:2, .6:3, .7:3, .8:3, .9:3, .10:2, .11:1, .12:2, .13:1 = 31 total. Parent integrity: every leaf's parent exists, 0 orphans.

2. ACYCLICITY (hierarchy-inclusive): union of parent-child + all dependency edges over the ENTIRE store (41038-line export) — 0 cycles via DFS.

3. SEQUENCING verified by re-read: corpus .6.3 <- .6.1/.6.2; CI .10.1 <- .7.3/.8.3/.9.3; .10.2 <- .10.1; docs .13.1 <- .10.2/.11.1/.12.2; RF chain .11.1 <- x7hh.2/.9.3/.12.2 and .4.2 <- x7hh.2; frame-budget .1.4 <- human bead ljgs.

4. READY FRONTIER real: exactly 10 leaves ready (x7hh.1.1/.1.2/.1.3, .2.1, .2.3, .3.1, .3.2, .4.1, .5.1, .5.2); SHOULD-BE-BLOCKED leak check over 20 gated leaves: NONE exposed ready. Note for workers: .2.3 (grantee/legal adjudication) carries the human label — it is Mark's, agents must skip it per worker loop rules (process gate, not a dependency gate).

5. CLOSED STATUSES preserved: q74u, q74u.1, q74u.2, 9zla.1 all still closed (verified via bd show — bd list default output excludes closed records, initial per-export count of 0 was a query artifact, re-verified). No x7hh bead closed.

6. GATES/DEFERRALS preserved: 9zla.2 = deferred; x7hh.2.3 labeled human; x7hh.11.1 + x7hh.4.2 labeled blocked:hardware.

7. ACTUAL COUNTS: x7hh family 14 original (14 open) + 31 leaves (31 open) = 45 beads; q74u family 3 closed; 9zla family 1 open + 1 closed + 1 deferred; hpc8 family 4 (.1 and .2 closed, .3 this audit, epic open).

VERDICT: decomposition conforms to hpc8 acceptance criteria. No defects found; no corrective beads needed.
